identity_impact: The upstream attribution, methodology-only adoption, project-authored task public and hidden identities, scenarios, execution contract, deterministic oracle and mutations, researcher model/prompt/adapter/environment, benchmark mode, sample seed, sandbox capability/image/entrypoint/limits, refinement policy and denominator are immutable benchmark identities. evidence_level: Strategy-code benchmark records are external researcher-quality observations only. They are not Candidate, Strategy Package, Workspace formal run, Runtime formal evidence, Evidence v2, qualification, reporting, or production approval.
fail_closed_behavior: Unknown or drifted upstream, task provenance, public/hidden view, scenario, source, execution, oracle, mutation, researcher, sandbox, budget, feedback, attempt, or denominator identity fails before spend, execution, scoring, or successor publication. Production execution requires the attested SPEC-005 OCI path; no host fallback, alternate data source, model judge override, backtester, ledger, registry, or evidence truth is allowed.
